title: Communications Technician
description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years.  Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.

Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.

The company's state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 14 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite.  For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit

Reporting to the Manager, Satellite Operations, the Communications Technician performs real time Telemetry, Track and Control (TT&C) of all satellites operated by Telesat Brazil and monitors ground systems according to established procedures and policies;  is responsible for all aspects of successful in-orbit mission operations; serves as an interface to internal and external customers, as it relates to the daily transponder accesses; and is responsible for the overall ground station or facilities operations.

Responsibilities: Satellite In-Orbit Operations
  • Monitor all in-orbit satellite performance.
  • Provide routine operations to maintain the satellite orbit and subsystems health.
  • Provide emergency system operations in accordance with contingency plans;
  • Respond immediately to all anomalous events and/or alarms;
  • Prepare anomaly reports to engineers for further investigation;
  • Operate, configure and monitor satellite subsystems, including: Power, Thermal, Reaction Control, Attitude, TT&C, and Communications;
  • Perform station keeping maneuvers, battery reconditioning, eclipse operations, and other routine operations;
  • Maintain and operate ground station TT&C equipment: Antenna Control Units, Command, Ranging and Telemetry racks, and Command Encryption modules;
  • Maintain and operate front-end processors and associated computers;
  • Conduct special satellite testing as directed by satellite engineering/management.
Responsibilities: Customer Service Operations
  • Answer incoming calls from Uplinkers, Customers, and persons requesting information.
  • Perform Uplinker performance checks and transponder-access tests, including Transponder frequency, Polarization, Deviation, and Power.  Correlate power/polarization level adjustments with field technicians.
  • Monitor consoles, maintain event logs, and enter information into databases.
  • Perform troubleshooting of reported video and audio troubles using appropriate test equipment.
  • Identify and escalate service outages and abnormal conditions.
  • Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods.
  • Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets.
  • Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering.
  • Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans.
  • Assist Engineering and customer Field Engineers as requested.
  • Perform in-service 'Console Transponder Calibration' tests using supplied hardware/software.
  • Setup consoles and monitor audio teleconferencing bridges for satellite news feeds.
  • Perform calibration tests on spectrum analyzers and other equipment used in the Service Assurance Center (SAC).
  • Coordinate customer additions and disconnects' as directed by scheduled Service Orders.
  • Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering.
  • Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences.
  • Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers.
Responsibilities: Ground Station/Facilities Operations
  • Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT;
  • Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment;
  • Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log;
  • Maintain and update facility site documentation;
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance;
  • Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management;
  • Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis;
  • Prepare and distribute (E-mail) daily reports;
  • File completed logs;
  • Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on-line and spare parts;
  • Monitor building, fire, and security systems.
  • Handle on-call, special and In-Charge assignments
Education and Experience required
  • Technical specialization (Certified Technician) on Telecommunications or Electronics.
  • Ability to write, read and speak on both English and Portuguese languages.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals;
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence;
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.
Decision making and Supervision
  • Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action;
  • Receives instructions on new assignments or projects;
  • Actively seeks information and guidance to improve own performance.
  • There is no staff reporting to this position.
Working conditions
  • 12 x 36 (or similar) shift work
  • Working onsite in office
  • Occasional travel
  • Occasional visits to customer sites

At Telesat, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer that values equality in the workplace.   We are committed to providing the best candidate experience possible including any required accommodations at every stage of our interview process.   All qualified applicants that have been selected for an interview that require accommodations, are advised to inform the Telesat Talent team accordingly.  We will work with you to meet your needs.   All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential.

title: lactarista - maternidade maria amélia buarque de hollanda
description:
O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.
Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.
O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Preparar fórmulas de composições lácteas, hídricas e dietas enterais a serem utilizadas nas diversas áreas, bem como efetuar a higienização de embalagens, bicos, mamadeiras e outros;
Preparar fórmulas lácteas enterais, dentro das especificações predeterminadas pelos Nutricionistas;
Administrar os insumos para a produção, através da requisição dos produtos, conferência dos mesmos, conservação e separação, com o objetivo de atender a demanda estabelecida;
Preparar, identificar, envasar e distribuir fórmulas lácteas e enterais;
Preparar sopas, papas sucos de frutas, efetuando a distribuição de acordo com a divisão em porções adequadas, considerando para a distribuição a identificação antecipada de cada paciente que receberá o alimento;
Utilizar técnicas dietéticas de preparo de alimentos;
Efetuar a esterilização das fórmulas lácteas, após o término da preparação, utilizando para a esterilização o equipamento autoclave;
Efetuar a esterilização dos utensílios utilizados, tais como: frasco de mamadeira, bico, arruelas, protetores de bico, mantendo o padrão de higiene estabelecido, evitando dessa forma o acumulo de resíduos que possam adulterar o conteúdo dos alimentos;
Coletar amostras das preparações confeccionadas no Lactário, seguindo técnicas padrão de coletas para controle microbiológico das mesmas;
Verificar a temperatura ambiente diária e a temperatura dos equipamentos de refrigeração instalados no Lactário, evitando que uma eventual variação brusca na temperatura do ambiente ou do equipamento possa alterar a composição dos alimentos estocados;
Zelar pela organização, conservação e limpeza dos utensílios e dependências do local de trabalho utilizado pelo ocupante do cargo, seguindo normas e instruções para manter a ordem e a higiene local;
Operar equipamentos obedecendo às instruções de uso, bem como, informar ao superior imediato a necessidade de compra ou reparos de equipamentos ou utensílios que necessitem de reposição a fim de atender a demanda de atividades diárias;
Desenvolver as atividades, aplicando normas e procedimentos de biossegurança;
Zelar pelo descarte dos resíduos provenientes do seu local de trabalho;
Informar ao Nutricionista, qualquer intercorrência ocorrida durante a jornada de trabalho;
Informar ao superior imediato do lactário a necessidade de compra ou reparos de equipamentos ou utensílios que necessitem de reposição, a fim de atender a demanda de atividades diárias;
Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.
Requisitos e qualificações
Possuir Ensino Médio Completo;
Possuir experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Copeira Hospitalar ou Lactarista;
Possuir fácil acesso ao Centro do rio
Possuir disponibilidade de horário - Plantão 12x36 (dia a ser definido)
Informações adicionais
Trabalho 100% presencial;
Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
Horário de trabalho: Escala 12x36 - turno diurno - plantão ainda a ser definido;
Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculos com grau de parentesco ou atividade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vinculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de H vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

title: Gerente de Tecnologia de Negócios
description:
Na GSK, somos movidos por ambições audaciosas para transformar vidas e gerar um impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Nossas Global Functions estão no centro dessa missão, atuando como pilares estratégicos que conectam todas as áreas da empresa e garantem que nossas operações sejam conduzidas com excelência, eficiência e responsabilidade.

Ao unir inovação, colaboração e uma visão global, nossas funções globais tornam possível o desenvolvimento de nossas vacinas, medicamentos e inovações científicas, apoiando cada etapa do processo até que as soluções cheguem aos pacientes. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para um futuro mais saudável e sustentável, trabalhando em um ambiente onde propósito e impacto caminham juntos.
 

Essa posição ficará baseada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Suas Responsabilidades

Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ  a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico de tecnologia, traduzindo necessidades de negócios em soluções escaláveis e inovadoras em dados, analytics e IA.

  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders internos e externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico.

  • Definir requisitos de dados e analytics que gerem valor mensurável ao negócio.

  • Garantir alinhamento das soluções com arquitetura corporativa, segurança e governança.

  • Integrar múltiplas fontes e plataformas de dados, com foco na qualidade e consistência.

  • Evoluir o ecossistema de dados e analytics, habilitando casos de uso avançados de IA e promovendo a sustentabilidade das soluções.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:

Estamos à procura de pessoas/profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência prévia em empresas farmacêuticas em posições gerenciais, como Tech Business Partner ou Data/Insights Manager.

  • Conhecimento sólido em Data & Analytics, arquitetura de tecnologia e processos de integração de dados.

  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de equipes técnicas de engenharia de dados.

  • Conhecimento em sistemas corporativos como DataBricks e ferramentas de análise avançada (preferencial).

  • CNH válida (Categoria B) e disponibilidade para viagens.

#LI-Remote

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people

title: analista de suporte
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.
A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview


At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview


The Cloud Platform Services organization is the engine behind our global safety and security ecosystem. We don't just build software; we build the bridges that connect critical information to the heroes who need it most. Our mission is to help public safety professionals and enterprises find the "needle in the haystack" by leveraging cutting-edge AI, video, audio, and advanced search analytics. By transforming massive oceans of data into clear, actionable intelligence, we empower people to be their best in the moments that matter.

Job Description


As a Software Engineer on our Data Platform Search team, you will play a pivotal role in Solving for Safer by increasing the discoverability of life-saving data. You won't just write code; you will design and implement the search architecture that helps a dispatcher or first responder locate critical information in seconds.

Your day-to-day will involve taking ownership of significant features, from initial technical design to final deployment within a Kubernetes environment. You will act as a human-centered innovator—partnering with teams to nail down requirements, conducting rigorous code reviews, and ensuring our systems remain secure and resilient. Whether you are optimizing a microservice or mentoring a junior team member, your work directly contributes to a world where clarity is power and context is key.

Basic Requirements


Location:

This is a remote position located in Brazil. You'll be working with a team with core hours of 9:00 - 15:00 MST/MDT. Occasional meetings can be scheduled for as early as 8:00 MST/MDT and as late as 17:30 MST/MDT.

## Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years of professional experience in object-oriented programming (C#/.NET or Java)
  • Advanced English Proficiency
  • Proven experience developing REST-based and Messaging-based APIs within cloud-based microservice architectures (e.g., Kubernetes)
  • Deep practical knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and modern DevOps practices including CI/CD and automation
  • Solid understanding of secure coding principles and common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

## Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Haves):

  • Experience building or maintaining search systems using Elasticsearch or equivalent technologies
  • Proficiency in CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Knowledge of data streaming and event ingestion services such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or EventHub
  • Familiarity with C4 Architecture diagrams and Domain-Driven Development (DDD)
  • Experience with Docker, NodeJS, and TypeScript

title: Grants - Senior Training Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Job Purpose
The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner, and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope
of work, HRSA guidance, and serves as a Training Coordinator for all activities planned by the project, including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects, including: Core, Minority AIDS Initiative, CDC, Inter-Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and COVID-19.
Supervisory Authority
Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.
Principal Accountabilities
Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV-related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills. Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
Organizing and facilitating monthly video conference calls, in person meetings, training events
Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/ subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
Works with subcontractors to ensure the programs are developed that identify training needs, and effectively reach targeted audience and enhance the quality of education. Manages the certification process for continuing education credits for the designated professions.
Increases the center's participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community-based organization, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
Participates in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
Supports the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
Maintaining files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and helping organize all required documentation to and from our funders and regional partner sites.
Meets Program Quarterly goals and creates reports for internal staff regarding
programmatic activities.
Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
Recruit new speakers.
Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with community-based agencies, local, and state government.
Prepare and submit monthly reports on projects outcome and related activities.
Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‐specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.
Advise individual clinical sites on the implementation of the interventions and measures, sharing specific best practice examples.
Serve as an active member of a practice transformation learning collaborative group.
Interact and collaborate with other practice coaches and planning groups. Receive training on practice coaching and the interventions and tools for site implementation.
Ensure implementation fidelity. Transparently share challenges and barriers regarding site implementation and share solutions for effectively implementing the interventions.
Work within the learning collaborative group to further refine the interventions,
measures, and associated tools. Research and develop innovative ideas for future spread of best practices.
Create and/or assist in the creation of materials and presentations and assist with logistical coordination of training events.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
Knowledge of the principles and procedures related to HIV education and training.
Ability to develop curriculum for programs.
Ability to use standard office equipment, which includes a computer and projector.
Ability to analyze and develop action plans in resolving and/or implementing
organizational and operational problems, issues and goals.
Competence in both oral and written English to communicate in a clear and concise manner.
Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and customers.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in related field with 2-5 years of related experience. 10 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$55,000-$65,000

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You'll Work With


The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You'll Solve


As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.
  • Quality & Timeliness: Ensure all data is extracted in a timely manner and meets our high standards for data quality.
  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Buscamos profissional para atuar na eficiência e a eficácia dos processos de custificação e conciliação do resultado de custo contábil versus reposição. No curto prazo, o principal desafio é estabelecer uma governança robusta para o processo, liderar iniciativas de automação e ciência de dados na área e apoiar a construção de uma visão analítica sobre custeio e contabilização. 

A médio e longo prazo, a função deve garantir a correta interpretação dos componentes de custos, analisar e explicar variações, propor soluções e identificar oportunidades de melhoria na principal linha do resultado.

  • Atender o time comercial e atuar como parceiro das áreas de Pricing, Trading e Operações, facilitando o entendimento e identificando oportunidades de otimização de processos e custos;

title: Engenheiro de Integridade Sênior
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior( Inspeção) que será responsável pela gestão da integridade e inspeção de dutos e equipamentos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposição de mitigação, garantindo a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade do sistema de transporte e o atendimento às regulamentações vigentes, com foco em Proteção Catódica e NR‑13/SPIE.

Responsabilidades:


  • Inspeção e Integridade: Planejar, acompanhar e aprovar inspeções de dutos e equipamentos, garantindo atendimento à NR‑13 e padrões de integridade.
  • Proteção Catódica: Monitorar potenciais elétricos, retificadores, interferências e condições de corrosão externa ao longo dos dutos.
  • Avaliação de Defeitos: Realizar análises de defeitos com base em normas técnicas (API 579, ASME B31.G, B31.8, entre outras).
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Atualizar e acompanhar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios técnicos e de suporte ao gestor.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Orientar técnicos, promover boas práticas de inspeção e fortalecer a cultura de integridade.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Selecionar, contratar e acompanhar serviços de inspeção e integridade em campo.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em inspeção, integridade, NR‑13  e proteção catódica.
  • Domínio: NR‑13, SPIE, Proteção Catódica, Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento: Avaliação de defeitos (API 579/ASME B31.G), ASME B31.8/B31.8S, PIGs, SCC, soldagem e reparos, ArcGIS/Google Earth, gestão de riscos e contratos.
  • Inglês intermediário (mínimo).

Diferencial:

  • Atuação ou disponibilidade para atuar como PLH.
  • Certificações em inspeção/END/soldagem.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Participação em eventos e fóruns técnicos

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo:

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa sólida, com propósito claro e que valoriza o bem-estar, o respeito.

Estamos em busca de um Manipulador de Laboratório para atuar diretamente nos processos produtivos do nosso laboratório magistral, contribuindo para a precisão, segurança e qualidade de cada formulação manipulada.

Responsabilidades:


• Encapsular e envasar produtos conforme as ordens de produção.


• Realizar higienização de equipamentos, utensílios e bancadas.


• Executar peso médio e conferências técnicas conforme procedimentos internos.


• Seguir normas, protocolos operacionais e utilizar corretamente os EPIs.

Requisitos:


• Ensino Médio completo.


• Atenção aos detalhes, organização e responsabilidade.


• Experiência prévia em laboratório é desejável, porém não obrigatória.

Horário de trabalho:


• Segunda a sexta-feira, de 08h às 17h.


• Sábados intercalados (após os primeiros 3 meses), de 07h às 11h.

Oferecemos:


• Treinamento técnico contínuo.


• Ambiente estruturado, seguro e orientado à qualidade.


• Acompanhamento próximo da liderança técnica.


• Remuneração compatível com o mercado.


• Premiação.


• Vale Refeição / Vale Alimentação.


• Plano Dental.


• Gympass.

Role Description

This is a part-time, on-site role for a Tax Compliance Officer located in the United Arab Emirates. The Tax Compliance Officer will be responsible for ensuring compliance with tax regulations, preparing accurate tax returns, and managing relevant documentation. The role involves analyzing financial data, staying informed about changes in tax laws, and advising on tax-related matters. This position requires collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders to address tax-related issues effectively.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Tax Compliance and Tax Preparation
  • Strong Analytical Skills and Finance knowledge
  • Understanding of Tax Law and its practical application
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage deadlines effectively
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills
  • Experience working in tax-related roles is an advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred

Manobrista

A Dealerhunter é a primeira HRTech especialista no setor automotivo da América. Conectamos profissionais de qualidade com as melhores empresas do setor.

Estamos em busca de um Manobrista responsável, cuidadoso e com bom relacionamento interpessoal. Se você tem experiência em conduzir veículos com segurança e gosta de trabalhar com organização e agilidade, essa pode ser a vaga ideal para você
